newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outpace U.S., Canada again.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outpace U.S., Canada again.

text.p: The Australian bond market put in another strong outperformance against the U.S. and Canada in largely technical driven trade.

The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread shrunk to its lowest level since mid-February after the local futures broke out of a declining channel which had prompted U.S. hedge funds to take profits on short positions, traders said.

The local firm tone came despite Friday's weakness in U.S. Treasuries following the labour force report, which has led the market to believe that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates again when the Federal Open Market Comittee meets in May.
The 10-year spread to Canada also continued to tumble with the Canadian market still under pressure from a declining local currency since the Fed tightened policy on March 25.
Spreads to New Zealand were little changed with the market there taking some inspiration from Australia having soundly underperformed the bloc last week on U.S. selling.
